node.title: Re: Perl Script to Run other Scripts with proper pauses?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The script that will run the others is in the same directory as them

As I mentioned in my post [id://1194275|here], it would be best if you use absolute pathnames. If you don't want to work with hard coded paths in your scripts, here's one thing you can do instead to still get absolute paths (note [doc://File::Spec] and [doc://FindBin] are core modules):

use File::Spec::Functions qw/catfile/; use FindBin; my $scriptname = catfile($FindBin::Bin, "foo.pl");
